'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male professor with the habit of repeating his opening lecture. He can be found in the Light Energy Sciences classroom during the afternoon. 

{{color|help|Players can attend Professor Chevreuler class at <nowiki>06:00-11:59</nowiki> in the Light Energy Sciences Classroom.}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Chevreuler:''' Be extra careful when picking wild Edelschnee seeds.
:'''Chevreuler:''' Their tendrils secrete a paralytic agent when they sense other organisms.
:'''Chevreuler:''' They use it to hunt injured animals, but some larger creatures have learned to use the Edelschee to their advantage.
:'''Chevreuler:''' The food web out here on the frostlands is incredibly fragile, which is why it's developed this symbiotic relationship...

:'''Chevreuler:''' Never underestimate this Lichen. Its history predates the arrival of the Exostrider.
:'''Chevreuler:''' If we keep pushing its cultivation, we could actually transform those barren wastelands out there.
:'''Chevreuler:''' Oh, I should also add that it's the foundation of our super-food manufacturing process.
:'''Chevreuler:''' The cup noodles you love so much wouldn't exist without it.

:'''Dewar: '''Here it comes, here it comes!
:'''Dewar: '''I bet you five cup noodle coupons. No backsies.

==Dialogue==
;(First time interaction with the crowd gathered around another Rabelle College student)
:'''Stephan:''' Hey, where did you come from? Are you a transfer student?
:'''Josiah:''' I know you! You're from Rabelle College, aren't you?
;(Observe the situation)
:'''Josiah:''' I saw him with Professor Mornye the other day.
:'''Stephan:''' Tell me, how's the  food in your cafeteria? Is it like toothpaste?
:'''Vika:''' Quiet down over there! What are you? A bunch of Fluffguins?
:'''Vika:''' You always swarm whenever someone new shows up.
:'''Vika:''' Interrupt my lecture again, and I'll have you standing in the frostlands like real Fluffguins.
----
;Sit down
:'''Rover:''' I know this class...
:{{DIcon}} (Pay close attention.)
::'''Chevreuler:''' Ahem. Today's lesson is about to start, everyone...
::'''Dewar:''' "What is considered indispensable to the functioning of human society?"
::'''Chevreuler:''' What is considered indispensable to the functioning of human society?
::'''Dewar:''' "Energy!"
::'''Chevreuler:''' Energy! And we, we must master the knowledge of creating energy itself.
::'''Dewar:''' See? What did I tell you? Professor Chevreuler always starts his lectures with the same question.
::'''Aisha:''' All right, all right. You win. Just take it.
:{{DIcon}} (Doze off.)
{{Dialogue End}}
